blocks.text: Google Cloud revenues increased $11.1 billion and $18.9 billion from the three and six months ended June 30, 2025 to the three and six months ended June 30, 2026 primarily driven by growth in Google Cloud Platform largely from infrastructure and platform services. In addition, in the second quarter of 2026, we began recognizing revenue from the sale of TPU systems.
